rows.grounds: past participle of puṭ, accusative neuter singular
ablative singular of krama in compound with ṣaṣ

items.question: How should the six limbs be performed after being enclosed by māyā?
items.inference: The limbs are to be performed in sixfold order after being enclosed by māyā.
uncertainties: puṭitaṃ agreement with aṅgāni is unclear
items.plain_english: Having enclosed them with māyā, one should perform the limbs in sixfold order.
